It was for the case of his younger brother that Guan Hongfeng first had a falling out with the team and resigned, then just a few months later actually agreed to return to the team as a consultant. Zhou Xun's purpose in making this decision without my knowledge is definitely not pure.

sentences.translation: Once Guan Hongfeng gets involved in work-related issues with his younger brother, it will definitely affect you, and his subordinate Zhou Xun can also distance himself from the relationship.
sentences.explanation: The sentence warns that if Guan Hongfeng's work-related issues with his brother arise, it will impact the listener, and Zhou Xun can distance himself from the situation.
